prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Interactive flows (new_flow) delivered the largest wins (up to +14.8%), but predictions were often overly optimistic as several variants caused severe drops (down to -11.8%) or rollbacks.
Step reordering (reorder) drove major wins (up to +12.0%), though predictions overshot as several variants caused severe drops (down to -8.9%) or no clear effect was seen.
UI redesigns (redesign) frequently caused severe drops (down to -14.1%), but recent layout redesigns yielded strong wins (up to +8.5%), vastly outperforming pessimistic predictions.
Wait-state information (wait_info) produced several solid wins (up to +6.1%), though for many variants no clear effect was seen.
Targeted copy changes (copy) achieved selective wins (up to +6.7%), particularly around account protection and retrieval, while for most variants no clear effect was seen.
Hints, notifications, layout changes, and standalone preview screens yielded no wins, with hints occasionally worsening performance (down to -3.1%) and no clear effect seen for the rest.

- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)

- finish, new_screen: -2.5% over 1 test(s)

- home, hint: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +1.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.2% over 10 test(s)

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Controls Calibration Sandbox: Add an interactive sandbox flow directly inside home_intro where users test controlling, hiding, and summoning their pet on screen before completing onboarding. (why: Support emails show users are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding (3 emails), and finish step drop-off is 24.8%.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Post-Launch Desktop Control Reference Screen: Introduce a new_desktop_reference screen in finish step providing an interactive cheat sheet of pet hotkeys, desktop tray controls, and voice commands. (why: Support feedback highlighted confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup (3 emails), and finish step conversion is 75.2%.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live Desktop Rendering Stage & Health Indicator: Add a real-time system status and pet rendering stage progress indicator to the waiting screen with explicit preparation estimates. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing on desktop or app failing to open, and waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Account Retrieval & Multi-Pet Preservation Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to reassure users that signing in restores existing pets and prevents account reset issues. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making this the single largest support complaint.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Duration & Fast-Track Clarification Copy: Update choose_path copy to explicitly set time expectations (under 2 minutes) and reassure users that settings can be changed later. (why: choose_path mean time is 514s with 21.7% drop-off. Setting explicit low-friction expectations reduces initial drop-off.)
5: [home, hint] Waiting Screen Desktop Display & Permissions Guidance Hint: Add a helpful hint on the waiting screen reassuring users about background desktop rendering and multi-monitor setup compatibility. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app not opening, while home step wait median is 201s.)
